title: Apple : Angela Ahrendts to Leave Company in April, Deirdre O'Brien to Lead Retail | MarketScreener
text:
By Josh Beckerman
Apple Inc. (AAPL) said its retail boss Angela Ahrendts will leave the company in April "for new personal and professional pursuits."
Deirdre O'Brien is taking on new responsibilities for Apple's retail and online stores in an expanded role as senior vice president of Retail + People, the company said Tuesday.
Write to Josh Beckerman at josh.beckerman@wsj.com
